# A vLLM V1 /metrics dump, trimmed to the families workingset.metrics reads.
#
# Metric names, types, labels and bucket boundaries were read out of vLLM's
# own source (vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, vllm/v1/spec_decode/metrics.py,
# vllm/v1/metrics/perf.py) at v0.25.1 and at a post-0.28 main; the Prometheus
# surface is identical between the two. Every series carries model_name and
# engine (the engine index, as a string).
#
# NOT hand-written. The numbers come from simulating 1900 requests and then
# deriving every bucket count AND every _sum from the same draws, because a
# hand-written cumulative histogram plus a guessed _sum is easy to make
# INFEASIBLE: bucket counts imply
#     sum >= SUM_i count_i * lower_bound_i
# and an earlier revision of this file violated that on two families.
# tests/test_metrics.py asserts those bounds so it cannot regress.
#
# Identities that hold by construction:
#   prompt_tokens_by_source{local_compute + local_cache_hit} = prompt_tokens
#   prefix_cache_queries = prompt_tokens, prefix_cache_hits = prompt_tokens_cached
#   request_prompt_tokens_sum = prompt_tokens, request_generation_tokens_sum = generation_tokens
#   iteration_tokens_total_sum = local_compute prompt tokens + generation tokens
#   request_prefill_time_sum + request_decode_time_sum = request_inference_time_sum
#   request_queue_time_sum + request_inference_time_sum = e2e_request_latency_sum
#   spec_decode accepted_per_pos sums to spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens
#   drafts + accepted = generation_tokens (one verify step per output event)
#   inter_token_latency_count = output events - requests   (NOT generation
#     tokens: stats.py appends one ITL per output EVENT, a spec-decode step
#     accepting 3 tokens records ONE, and the first output books a TTFT)
#   request_time_per_output_token_count = finished requests
#   every _bucket series is cumulative and its +Inf bucket equals _count
#
# Included on purpose:
#   - an escaped label value, on request_success_total
#   - a NaN gauge, on a series nothing reads
#   - the `_created` series prometheus_client emits next to every counter
#
# HELP vllm:cache_config_info Information of the LLMEngine CacheConfig
# TYPE vllm:cache_config_info gauge
